Rumor has it that new Apple products will be released on October 13, including an upgraded Apple TV 4K. Below are the two main rumored upgrades for the new Apple TV.

#1: Siri AI

When Apple first unveiled Siri AI this past June, it was positioned as a cross-platform revolution, with a consistent functional experience regardless of the device users are on.

The new Siri has already made its appearance on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and Vision Pro. But notably absent from any mention has been support for Siri AI on Apple TV or HomePod. Among the OS 27 updates rolled out last month, tvOS and HomePod software were the only two systems that did not include the new Siri.

That is about to change, however, as Siri AI is reportedly set to be a major feature of the new Apple TV 4K.

Based on how Siri AI has performed on other platforms, this would mark a significant upgrade for tvOS users. In addition to smarter understanding of TV shows and movies, more accurate content recommendations, and likely powering an enhanced InSight feature, the new Siri should also be able to answer general knowledge questions just like on other devices.

#2: Upgrade from current A15 Bionic to an A19-class chip

The Apple TV 4K has not been refreshed since 2022, with that model featuring the A15 chip that first appeared in 2021.

But rumors suggest that the new Apple TV 4K arriving next week will bring a major chip upgrade, equipped with an A19 or A19 Pro chip.

Leaker Aaron Perris discovered a new hardware identifier in Apple code labeled "AppleTV18,1". This "18,1" designation was also used for the iPhone 17 series, suggesting the new device will use an A19-class chip.

I suspect it will be the A19 Pro rather than the A19, since the latter does not support the customized Siri AI voice speed and tone performance. Given that Siri AI is one of the main selling points of the new Apple TV, going with the A19 Pro seems like the safer bet.
